refinement.reason: A single full ObserverBinding identity is correct for provenance but too strict as the equality key for matched intervention/control measurement methods when each arm is produced by a different instance of the same exact observer implementation/configuration.

observer_method.meaning: Stable declared measurement-method/config/evidence-semantics identity. Equality is a matching witness only, not proof of measurement correctness or causal validity.

observer_binding.meaning: Full per-instance/run producer lineage that references one immutable ObserverMethod identity.

placement_and_matching_law.cell_uptake_receipt: Serialize observer_binding_sha256 at leaf scope and validate the source ObserverBinding before summary admission. No cross-receipt equality requirement is implied.
placement_and_matching_law.causal_probe_arm: Serialize observer_binding_sha256 at each arm leaf for provenance and keep access to the exact source binding/method witness needed for validation.
placement_and_matching_law.evaluate_causal_influence: After existing probe-id/nonbroadcast-input/context prerequisites and before positive causal classification, compare intervention.observer_method_sha256 with control.observer_method_sha256. Mismatch returns an UNKNOWN-like unmatched-observer status; do not require full observer_binding_sha256 equality.
placement_and_matching_law.probe_execution_context: R6-SEED-012 remains a separate shared-context witness. Both execution-context matching and observer-method matching are required when each dimension is material.

e4_falsifier.adjudication: Full-binding equality overbinds instance identity; no observer-method gate underbinds measurement semantics; nested method-digest equality is the smallest discriminator supported by this source-schema ablation.

trigger4_acceptance_addendum: Add a negative regression where intervention/control use different observer methods with otherwise matched current prerequisites and differing outputs; predecessor should reproduce the current positive classification before repair.
Add a same-method/different-instance regression that must remain eligible for the prior causal classification after the method gate is introduced.
Reject malformed or stale ObserverMethod/ObserverBinding identity and digest mismatch fail-closed.
Ensure full binding digests remain different across different instances even when observer_method_sha256 is equal.
Ensure method/config/evidence-class mutation changes observer_method_sha256 and therefore blocks matched causal promotion until revalidated.
Do not compare observer_instance_id or full binding digest as the causal matching key unless a narrower exact runtime requirement explicitly demands it.
Preserve R6-SEED-012 ProbeExecutionContext matching and WP510 downstream revalidation; neither witness substitutes for the other.
authority_fences: ObserverMethod equality proves only equality of declared method/config/evidence-semantics fields.
ObserverBinding identity proves only declared producer-instance lineage.
Neither witness proves a real observer executed, measured correctly, or established hidden-state causality.
No second provenance database/service is introduced.
next_exact_action: Trigger 4 must treat this addendum as refining—not replacing—the prior R6-SEED-013 handoff: preserve full ObserverBinding provenance on evidence leaves, factor a stable ObserverMethod identity, compare only method identity for probe-arm measurement matching, and run exact predecessor/repair regressions before any E6 credit.
